Vaibhav Sooryavanshi.primary_threat: Wide yorkers outside 5th stump with 2 boundary riders at deep point and sweeper cover.
Vaibhav Sooryavanshi.field_blueprint: Keep 3 boundary riders on off-side; bowl back-of-length cramping the body. Avoid giving room through off-side.
Vaibhav Sooryavanshi.coach_takeaway: Attacks from ball 1 (175 SR in balls 1-6 with tiny 2.6% dismissal rate). Does not panic in steep chases.

Finn Allen.primary_threat: Full straight seam deliveries attacking the stumps (25.5% Bowled dismissal rate!).
Finn Allen.field_blueprint: Bowl full and straight on off-and-middle. Place straight long-on back and deep midwicket on the rope.
Finn Allen.coach_takeaway: Lethal against spin (294.7 SR). Attack him with full straight pace in his first 6 balls before he adjusts.

Phil Salt.primary_threat: Inswinging deliveries into the pads in balls 1-6 (highest early dismissal rate: 5.4%).
Phil Salt.field_blueprint: Bowl tight incoming lines; place deep square leg and fine leg back for the mistimed pull shot.
Phil Salt.coach_takeaway: Vulnerable in his first 6 balls. Once set past ball 8, he strikes above 220 against both pace and spin.

Daryl Mitchell.primary_threat: Wide defensive yorkers delivered from wide of the crease; cutters into the pitch.
Daryl Mitchell.field_blueprint: Long-on and long-off straight back; bowl wide yorkers outside off-stump to deny down-the-ground power.
Daryl Mitchell.coach_takeaway: The world's safest collapse anchor: lowest early dismissal rate (2.08%) and lowest dot ball rate (31.2%). Perfect walk-in after early wickets.

Abhishek Sharma.primary_threat: Express 145+ km/h bouncers targeting helmet badge; 89.7% dismissals are boundary catches.
Abhishek Sharma.field_blueprint: Post deep midwicket and deep backward square leg back; test him with high bouncers.
Abhishek Sharma.coach_takeaway: Unplayable against spin in powerplays (260.8 SR). Must be attacked with express short-pitched pace.

Suryakumar Yadav.primary_threat: Disciplined hard lengths outside off-stump; high-arm finger spin denying angle behind square.
Suryakumar Yadav.field_blueprint: Fine leg back on rope, deep third man back, deep extra cover back. Bowl wide off-stump hard lengths.
Suryakumar Yadav.coach_takeaway: 360-degree manipulator. Strikes at 222.4 vs pace under pressure. Squeeze him with finger spin into the pitch.

Ayush Mhatre.primary_threat: Slow gripping finger spin and googly variations in middle overs.
Ayush Mhatre.field_blueprint: Deploy spin choke in overs 7-12; protect straight boundaries.
Ayush Mhatre.coach_takeaway: 72.7% positive impact rate. Devastating against pace (250.6 SR) but strike rate drops to 162.5 vs spin.

Yashasvi Jaiswal.primary_threat: Sharp angle across from left-arm seamers bowling full outside off.
Yashasvi Jaiswal.field_blueprint: Deep backward point and deep cover; bowl across the left-hander.
Yashasvi Jaiswal.coach_takeaway: RR's cornerstone anchor (18.77% Lone Warrior share). Takes 4-6 balls to settle (48% dots early), then shifts into high gear.

Prabhsimran Singh.primary_threat: Holding lengths from off-spinners; sweepers placed on off-side boundary.
Prabhsimran Singh.field_blueprint: Pack the off-side circle; bowl slower cutters outside off-stump.
Prabhsimran Singh.coach_takeaway: High boundary intent. Strikes at 212.1 vs pace, but strike rate drops by 45 points against spin.

Mitchell Marsh.primary_threat: High-turning legspin bowling into front pad (LBW vulnerability).
Mitchell Marsh.field_blueprint: Bowl turning legspin on middle-and-leg stump line; deep midwicket back.
Mitchell Marsh.coach_takeaway: Heavy-ball power batter. Massive 19.01% Lone Warrior share, but struggles against turning wrist spin.

Jasprit Bumrah.tactical_blueprint: The ultimate LHB killer (7.40 econ). Bowl overs 17 and 19 with 4 wide yorkers and 2 searing slower bouncers.
Jasprit Bumrah.coach_directive: When opposition sends left-handers to counter spin, bring Bumrah immediately.

Josh Hazlewood.tactical_blueprint: Peak middle-overs enforcer (9.54 econ). Bowl overs 1-15; avoid overs 19-20 where death economy rises to 11.58.
Josh Hazlewood.coach_directive: Pair him with Trent Boult in the powerplay. Do not save for the final over.

Rashid Khan.tactical_blueprint: Death overs spin weapon: death economy (9.03) is LOWER than middle overs! Bowl over 17 or 18.
Rashid Khan.coach_directive: Use his quick-arm googly to break stubborn death-over partnerships.

Nathan Ellis.tactical_blueprint: Highest WPA/ball (+0.0253). Master of the wide yorker and back-of-the-hand dipping slower ball.
Nathan Ellis.coach_directive: Elite overseas death specialist. Bowl overs 16, 18, and 20 using deceptive back-of-the-hand slower balls and yorkers.

Sunil Narine.tactical_blueprint: World #1 Lone Enforcer (+2.19 RPO vs teammates). 8.62 death economy. Absolute choke hold.
Sunil Narine.coach_directive: Use in overs 12-18 when RRR is above 10. Forces opposition into panic strokes.

Krunal Pandya.tactical_blueprint: Lowest overall pressure economy (8.07 RPO). Devastating against LHBs (7.24 economy).
Krunal Pandya.coach_directive: Deploy in overs 7-14 against left-handed middle orders to squeeze the scoring rate.

Harpreet Brar.tactical_blueprint: 9.03 pressure economy overall. Dismisses marquee right-handers (Kohli, Maxwell) with arm balls.
Harpreet Brar.coach_directive: RR's top domestic spin target. Bowl overs 5, 8, 11, and 13.

Joshua Little.tactical_blueprint: Highest consistency rate in cricket (70.4% positive impact matches). 8.82 death economy.
Joshua Little.coach_directive: Elite left-arm pace variety. Bowl hard lengths into the pitch in overs 15, 17, and 19 to cramp hitters.

Varun Chakravarthy.tactical_blueprint: 8.87 overall pressure economy. Middle-overs squeeze (8.63 RPO) forces mistimed aerial chips.
Varun Chakravarthy.coach_directive: Bowl overs 8, 10, 12, and 14 to kill the opposition's momentum.

Bhuvneshwar Kumar.tactical_blueprint: Veteran executioner: 566 pressure balls (466 in IPL). Knuckle balls and reverse swing yorkers.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar.coach_directive: Veteran clutch master with 566 pressure balls experience. Bowl knuckle balls, wide yorkers, and reverse swing.
